title: TEJAURA Approval Contract
description: Schema for an explicit human-owner approval request and decision record enforcing non-self-approval.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task awaiting or governed by this approval.

action.description: Explicit sensitive or gated action requiring owner authorization.

requested_by.description: Identifier of the requesting agent or module.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when approval was requested.

status.description: Current decision state of the approval request.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the human owner who reviewed the request, or null if not yet reviewed. Must never be an agent or the requester.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the owner reviewed the request, or null while pending.

reason.description: Plain-language rationale explaining why approval is needed or why it was approved/rejected.

scope.description: Bounded least-privilege authorization scope granted if approved.

resources.description: Explicit target resource identifiers covered by this approval.

permissions.description: Explicit permission scopes covered by this approval.

single_use.description: Whether this approval expires immediately after a single execution.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC expiration timestamp for time-bounded approvals.

schema_version.description: Optional semantic version of this approval contract.
